evidence.FACTS: Template filler removed. Uses only confirmed NAP (Ngõ 5 Nguyễn Văn Cừ, Bồ Đề, Long Biên, near Bến xe Gia Lâm; 09:00–21:00 daily; 0334 699 969 / +84 334 699 969 tel/Zalo/WhatsApp) and owner price facts (150 000–200 000 VND/day semi-auto and scooter; own rows for 50cc, Vision, Air Blade; electric day rate 'selon le modèle'; weekly/monthly not derived from day rate) with the exact disclaimer. evidence.INTENT: Primary intent: step-by-step guide to preparing a motorbike rental in Hanoi (keyword seed 'guide location moto hanoi'). The homepage owns the broad commercial query 'location moto hanoi' (rates + contact); this pillar covers process and choices and links to the homepage once. Distinct from /location-moto-hanoi/courte-duree/ and /longue-duree/ (duration-specific), /prix-location/ (rate comparison) and /types-motos/ (vehicle comparison), which it summarises and links.
